lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Log on the shoulder. Twelve more and this lane's clear.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Cradle's emptied. Decks are filling nicely. Keep them coming.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: That team carry earlier was the cleanest one yet. Same again.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Cradle's full and the decks are stacked to the top, boss. The fire's the bottleneck, not the crew.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Hauling, boss. Route's clear, logs are moving. That's all I ask of a day.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Stack them butt to butt. Tidy deck, quick fire.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Dale, you've got the heavy end. Don't make that face.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Mud on the haul road. Short steps, people.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Last load's in. Fire's banked. Everyone inside before dark.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Report, boss: I've been delivering all day. Lost count past twenty, which annoys me more than the walking.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Route's blocked by a fallen crown. Clear it, or we all walk the long way round.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Swap shoulders at the stump. You'll thank me tomorrow.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Fire pile's hungry. Feed it the dry ones first.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Lost half the morning waiting on that yard. Making it up now.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Half the island's gone, and the walk to the yard gets longer every day.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Wind's on the fire. Keep the decks clear of the sparks.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Tomas is hauling faster than last week. Someone tell him before he apologises for it.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Day twenty-something. I could walk this haul road with my eyes shut.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Fire burns slow, boss. Like a budget. You can't rush either one.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Handcart's free. Load it to the rail, no higher, and push.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: No. I'll count them myself and tell you which number is higher.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: This one's got a personality. Mostly heavy.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: I'll take the heavy one, mate. I always take the heavy one. Somebody write that down.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Good team carry earlier, mate. We should charge extra for synchronised walking.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Biscuit, you're walking right where my feet go. Crust for you if you shift.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Carrying, mate. Big ones to the cradle. The little ones I leave for the others.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Cradle's full, mate. I'm stood here holding a log like a very boring statue.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Neat deck, this. Layered up like a proper club sandwich.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Wet log, mate. Slippery as a fish and twice as rude.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Fire's got a good bed of coals going. Could cook a sausage on that.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Marta, how many have you carried? Go on. Then ask me how many I've carried.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Last log of the day. Then dinner. Then a second, smaller dinner.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Tomas, mate, lift with your legs, yeah? Your back's not a forklift.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Lost count of what I've delivered today. Big number. Very impressive. Trust me.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Company gets a hundred a tree, mate. I'd settle for a hot pie per trunk.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Fire's spitting at the rain. Can't say I blame it.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Route's clogged with sections, mate. Can't get round without climbing over.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Ten days of hauling. My shoulders have got their own postcode now.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Longer walk to the yard every day. Should've built the thing on wheels.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Hand me the next one, mate. This deck's nearly as tall as me.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: This is my thinking face, Marta. I'm thinking about lunch.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: It landed exactly where I wanted, Joan. Eventually.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Shorter path through the stumps on the left. Eleven paces saved.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Deck three is two logs from full. The fire pile can take four.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Report, boss: I've delivered steadily today. The fire is burning slower than we're stacking.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: The cradle is full, boss, and the decks too. Until the fire catches up, carrying more just moves the queue.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: We matched step on that team carry. Did you notice? It's much easier in rhythm.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Wet logs weigh more. Not much, but you feel it by the tenth.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: This log's still green. Should it go on the fire now, or season on the deck?

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: The wind's carrying sparks east. Nothing downwind but stumps and bare ground.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Stacking the decks, boss. Largest at the bottom, so nothing rolls.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Fresh tracks across the haul road. Small, four toes, claws showing. A fox, I think.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: There's a crown lying across the route by the big stump. Is anyone assigned to clear it?

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: The fire pile settles about a hand's width every hour. I measured it yesterday.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: The sun's on the ridge. About twenty minutes of usable light. Shall we make this the last?

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Dale carried two of the long ones in the time I carried one. Noted.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Cradle's clear. I'll move the top of the deck to the fire so there's room.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: With this much cleared, we could take a straighter line to the yard. Should we ask the boss?

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Have you noticed the logs from the north slope are heavier, boss? Denser wood, I think.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Something called out in the trees when the fire cracked. Southwest, far off. A bird, I'd guess.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Second log today that's rolled off the cradle's edge. The left side sits lower.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Just you. And me. Our muscles are tired. The logs weigh what they weighed this morning.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: I've got it. I think I've got it. Yes. Got it.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Second gear on the hill, first in the mud. The truck likes it that way.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Carrying, boss. It's like deliveries, except nobody signs for anything.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Our team carry earlier went well, didn't it? I didn't drop my end once.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: The haul road's turning to mud. Sorry if I slow down a bit.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Sorry, boss, the route's blocked. There's a pile of sections right across the track.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: It's getting dark. Is it okay if this is my last carry?

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Stacked it straight. I think. Is that straight? It's straight.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: If they let me load the truck bed properly, this would be three trips, not thirty.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: I've delivered a few today. That number's going in Ana's letter.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Sorry, is this deck the one for the fire, or the one for later?

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Report, boss: steady deliveries from me today. Nothing dropped. The cradle's taking them fine.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Quick steps now. Not running. Just quick.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Do the logs get heavier at the end of the day, or is that just me?

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: The fire's leaning in the wind. I'll stack from the other side.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: I can carry the medium ones without stopping now. That's new. Is that normal?

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: The cradle's full. I'll hold on to this one. Sorry, I'll just stand here.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Ten days and the truck still starts first try. Good truck.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Was that a branch snapping behind us? Sorry. Probably a pile settling.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Legs. Right. Sorry. I knew that, I just forgot it halfway.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Fire's going lovely. Could roast a chicken in there, if anyone had a chicken.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Mind your end, love. I'm not carrying you and the log.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Tending the fire, boss-love. Slow burn. Like a good stew.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Yard's stuffed, boss-love. Fire's eating as fast as it can, and you can't hurry a fire.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: That team carry earlier, love. We walked in step like a pair of old dancers.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Rain on the logs, rain on me. Somebody owes me a dry jumper.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Dale, love, toss another one that hard and the whole deck goes over.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Banking the fire for the night. Let it sulk till morning.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: I bet the company wants a photo of every deck, boss-love. They're that sort.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: How'd you sleep, sunshine? You're carrying like you had a nap on the way.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Big ones to the bottom, love. It's a log deck, not a house of cards.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Did you see Priya stack that deck? Straight as a ruler. Showing off, that is.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Back and forth, back and forth. Used to do this with crates of bottles.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Report, boss-love: I've had logs on the cradle all day, the fire's fed, and nobody's crying.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Route's jammed with sections, love. Like a cellar on delivery day.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Wind's throwing smoke straight at me. Of course it is.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Biscuit's following that log like it owes him money. Dale's been feeding him again.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: That fire's been going since day one. Half the island's been through it now.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Nearly the end of the contract and I've still got a barmaid's arms. Strong ones, mind.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: If it's on the fire, love, it's not cluttering my deck. In it goes.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Course it is, sunshine. Drop it on the deck and walk in with me.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Coming through with a log! Mind your heads.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Log's on the cradle. Next.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Grab the other end? This one's a two-person job.

lines.speaker: trait:stronger
lines.text: Heavy one. Don't worry, I've got it.

lines.speaker: trait:stronger
lines.text: Put another on top. I can take two of these.

lines.speaker: trait:timid
lines.text: Last carry, and then inside. Please.

lines.speaker: trait:hard_working
lines.text: Straight back for the next one. No point walking empty.

lines.speaker: trait:observant
lines.text: Deck on the left is leaning. Restack it before it slides.

lines.speaker: trait:sociable
lines.text: Walk back with me? The haul feels shorter with someone to talk to.

lines.speaker: trait:level_headed
lines.text: Yard's full. No point stewing. Let's tidy the decks while the fire catches up.

lines.speaker: trait:skeptical
lines.text: Fire crackles. That's all that noise is.

lines.speaker: trait:reliable_driver
lines.text: Truck's handling well on the haul road. The ruts are drying out.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Waiting on the cradle, boss. Someone's unloading ahead of me.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Nothing to carry near me, boss. Is there a pile somewhere else?

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Storm's picking up. Get this one in and we'll see.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Fire's struggling in the rain. Take the dry logs from the middle of the deck.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Watch the stump on your right. Ankle height, nasty.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Two-person carries are slow, but nobody's back gives out.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Fire pile's burned down a bit. Room for a few more.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Leave the rest on the deck. It'll keep till morning.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Same route, same log size, same sore shoulder.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Hardly anything left to haul from out here. Odd to see it so bare.

lines.speaker: trait:timid
lines.text: Sorry, boss. Something's lying across the route and I can't get past with this.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: That's my deliveries done for now. Fire's got plenty.

lines.speaker: trait:hard_working
lines.text: Cradle's clear. Let's get another load in before the fire catches up.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Dry day. Bark's light and the road's firm. Good hauling.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Load the handcart and push. Beats carrying them one at a time.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Got it. Lift on three.
